topic: Introduction to Partial Differential Equations (PDEs): Modeling a Changing World
target_audience: Undergraduate students in Science and Engineering

sections.title: The Hook: From a Single Point to a Surface
lecture_lines: ODEs track a single value over time.
Imagine a falling ball as a point.
PDEs describe entire shapes or fields.
Ripple effects spread in all directions.
Everything changes simultaneously across the surface.

Fade in a 2D mesh grid representing a field.
Animate the mesh with wave-like ripples across the surface.
Add label 'PDE' in #55C1FF above the rippling mesh.

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Concept of Multivariable Change
lecture_lines: Functions change with space and time.
Partial derivatives measure change per variable.
We freeze one variable to study another.

sections.title: Defining the PDE: The 'Curly d' (∂) Notation
lecture_lines: We use the curly 'del' symbol.
Equations relate rates of change together.
We solve for the unknown function 'u'.
animations: Large partial derivative symbol partial appears in center in #FFFFFF.
Display the relationship 'Time Rate = Curvature' in #FFD700.
Show a 3D surface plot changing shape based on its curvature.

sections.title: The Classic Example: The Heat Equation
lecture_lines: Heat moves from hot to cold.
Temperature changes based on surface curvature.
Sharp peaks lose heat very quickly.
Valleys warm up as heat flows in.
The entire distribution eventually becomes smooth.
animations: Show equation partial u / partial t = alpha * partial^2 u / partial x^2 in #FF4D4D.
Draw a horizontal rod with a red-to-blue color gradient.
Plot u(x) as a line graph with a sharp central peak.
Highlight the peak with a circle and label 'High Curvature'.
Animate the peak flattening into a smooth curve over time.

sections.title: Geometric Interpretation: Curvature and Flow
lecture_lines: Local constraints create global motion.
Nearby points influence each other's state.
This mimics physical forces like cloth tension.
Simple rules generate complex emergent behavior.
PDEs define the physics of our world.
animations: Show a grid of points with arrows pointing to neighbors.
Animate the grid waving to simulate cloth in motion.
Highlight high-stress areas of the grid in #FF00FF.

sections.title: Real-World Impact: Beyond the Textbook
lecture_lines: PDEs drive modern weather prediction models.
They simulate everything from flight to finance.
These equations are tools for global modeling.
